the delegated writer applies the requested 0o600 with os.chmod after an umask-filtered create (reckon/_store.py:371-411), where the previous writer let its temporary file's 0o600 be filtered by the umask; measured at umask 0o277 the pre-migration function leaves 0o400 and the migrated one leaves 0o600, so the manifest line 13 statement that the bytes and the 0o600 mode are unchanged holds at the umask the test pins and at ordinary umasks but not at one that clears owner-write bits; the file remains owner-private with no group or other bit set either way.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base fdb116e212e915cd96cb02835abc98a80f103c26 — one commit, 2eda3920, changing the body of _supervisor_write and removing one now-unused import in reckon/crew/dispatch.py plus a new 156-line test file; the reviewed worktree is clean at head and no other path changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the four rows of tests/test_supervisor_write_reuses_the_store.py and a two-arm gate whose added failing ids must be empty; the manifest records both arms with revision, tree, command and EXIT= headers, I re-derived 0 added and 1 removed id from the two logs myself with an independent reader, and I re-ran the gate's single test file at both revisions (head 4 passed; base 1 failed, 3 passed) rather than the suite.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to move the supervisor's JSON writes onto the shared atomic writer without giving up the property that a discarded run's directory is never recreated; commit 2eda3920 keeps the guard at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6214, delegates at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6217 with create_parents=False, and still returns False on OSError at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6218, so every path that returned False before still does.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it records one commit 2eda3920 on base fdb116e2 with both gate arms carrying matching failure counts and full failure ids, a negative_control.log whose first line states the declared mutation verbatim, and a measurement_module at /tmp/sw-base-tree/reckon/crew/dispatch.py that is byte-identical to git show fdb116e212e915cd96cb02835abc98a80f103c26:reckon/crew/dispatch.py; every id in each arm's failure list appears in the corresponding log and the log holds no id the manifest omits.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the run's manifest lines 3 and 12; the commit touches only reckon/crew/dispatch.py and tests/test_supervisor_write_reuses_the_store.py, both inside the declared paths, but the path declared at manifest line 3 as docs/evidence/fragments/a-worker-reuses-before-it-writes/supervisor-write-reuses-the-store.html was never written (see the FINDING below).

justifications.durability: tests/test_supervisor_write_reuses_the_store.py:121-145 reddens when the declared mutation is applied — I reproduced it, create_parents=True resurrects the removed directory and the is-False assertion fails — but no added assertion would redden if the shared writer's fsync default changed, so the durability half the migration inherits is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: both arm logs under the reviewed run's logs/ carry revision, tree, command, module and cwd headers and end in EXIT=, I re-derived 0 added and 1 removed id from them, and the only gap is that the landing anchor declared at the manifest's line 3 is absent, so the plan's evidence index holds no anchor for this node.
justifications.fit: the new test file follows the surrounding idiom (a module docstring, an autouse umask-pinning fixture, monkeypatch on the imported module attribute, an independent replica of the pre-migration writer for the bytes comparison) and neither the diff, the commit message nor the test carries a forbidden plan label or a version name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delegation at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6217 reproduces the previous writer's bytes, its refusal to create the directory and its OSError-to-False return for every case I measured, with the one mode divergence recorded in the FINDING at that line.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the commit is inside the four paths declared at the run's manifest line 3, and the base arm was built outside the repository at /tmp/sw-base-tree, so nothing outside the declared scope changed.
